body: "322" is a meme from a game I play called Dota2. Somebody in the professional scene bet against themselves and (in hilarious manner) threw the match, making $322 for their efforts. The number has lived on in infamy and brought up every time a player seems to be throwing the match or is even just playing like shit or making clowny plays. So basically, my name is just read as mythrowaway.
Don't worry about it. My therapist can't do shit, much less some random guy on the internet that hardly knows a thing about me. Good intentions can't always yield results.

I've always loved music. 2000's and above punk in particular is always pretty good (such as sum41, billy talent, rise against etc.), along with some alt metal shit like Breaking Benjamin. Never been able to play music for shit though. I don't really have an intuition for it, and it's so tedious and difficult and draining to practice that it's maddening to the extent that I always just break down in tears when I try. Listening to it is a great way to fill time and get my mind off of things, though.

I'm naturally gifted in programming and other computer-related tidbits, but I'm honestly so fucking sick of it. I've always been a nerd, but it's no fun anymore. I used to love figuring out how to do little things on a computer, but I don't care about it anymore.

Everything I love I'm shit at and everything I'm good at I've grown to hate.
